preheader: Prudentia steps down to 1200m at Te Rapa this Saturday for the Roy and Pam Browne Sprint (BM75) from Barrier 1.
title: The Sprint Test: Prudentia Returns to Te Rapa

hero_caption: PRUDENTIA DURING TRACK WORK AT WEXFORD STABLES, PREPARING FOR HER SPRINT TEST AT TE RAPA.
standfirst: A tactical shift sees our BM65 Te Rapa winner return to the Waikato turf this Saturday, dropping back to the 1200m sprint trip in peak physical condition.
body_1: Prudentia returns to the gates at Te Rapa this Saturday, 30 May, dropping back to a 1200m trip for the Roy and Pam Browne Sprint (BM75).
body_2: Following a gutsy third-place finish over 1400m on May 2—where she hit the line fastest in the final 100m—trainers Lance O'Sullivan and Andrew Scott have elected to drop her back in distance. This shift keeps her sharp, leveraging the strong tactical turn of foot she showed during her Te Rapa win in April.
body_3: The stable reports she is in peak physical order, trotting up soundly after clocking a steady 600m in 43.1 seconds last Saturday. Carrying a light 54.0kg from Barrier 1, she is perfectly positioned to save ground along the rail. We are monitoring the weather closely; any late-week rain will play heavily to her strengths.

quote.text: “She is sound and in great order. If we get some rain to put cut in the track, she will be highly competitive.”
quote.author: — Andrew Scott

cards.title: Inside Advantage
cards.text: Drawing Barrier 1 allows Prudentia to save ground on the fence, a tactic she used to perfection in her last placing at Te Rapa.

cards.title: Peak Fitness
cards.text: She has taken immense physical improvement since her last start on May 2, trotting up sound and showing plenty of energy in her recent track work.

cards.title: Tactical Distance Drop
cards.text: Dropping back to 1200m keeps her sharp and allows her to make a sustained, powerful run down the long Te Rapa straight.

cards.title: Weight Relief
cards.text: Carrying just 54.0kg gives her a major advantage against higher-rated runners in the Benchmark 75 grade.
